key_insight: A scene's appearance alone may not reveal how it will move. PhysiCalWorld proposes in-context physics calibration to help world models account for hidden physical properties rather than rely on typical training-set dynamics.
problem_solved: World models using a single frame or short observation history can miss properties such as mass distribution, joint damping, and surface friction, causing predictions to drift in unfamiliar scenes.
method: Introduce in-context physics calibration for world models.
Target hidden physical factors that influence how scenes evolve, beyond what current visual observations reveal.
